# OpenJooki core — contract v2 (generated by tools/build/apidoc.lua)

Do not edit: regenerate with `lua5.1 tools/build/apidoc.lua > docs/api-v2.md`. Design: docs/21 §8, ADR-0005.

## Topics

| Direction | Topic | Payload |
|---|---|---|
| page → Jooki | `/j/web/v2/cmd` | `{"v":2, "id":"<client id>", "type":"<command>", "payload":{…}}` |
| Jooki → page | `/j/web/v2/reply` | `{"v":2, "id":…, "ok":true}` or `{"v":2, "id":…, "ok":false, "error":{"code","field","message"}}` |
| Jooki → page | `/j/web/v2/state` | full: `{"v":2, "rev":n, "full":true, "state":{…}}` · patch: `{"v":2, "rev":n, "patch":{key: value}}` |
| Jooki → page | `/j/web/v2/event` | `{"v":2, "type":"…", "payload":{…}}` |

Error codes: `invalid_argument` (field names the culprit), `not_found`, `read_only`, `conflict`, `unavailable`, `internal`.

The v1 contract (`/j/web/input/*`, `/j/web/output/*`) is served by `core/api/v1.lua` for one release.

## State document keys

`device`, `health`, `library` {playlists, tracks, tokens}, `playback` {state, position_ms, now}, `audiocfg`, `resume`, `bedtime` {cfg, night, sleep}, `limits`, `net`, `bluetooth`, `power`, `nfc`, `userMessages`, `spotify`, `deezer`, `flags`, `system`, `config`.

## Commands (33)

### `bedtime.set`

Night mode settings: enabled, start/stop ("HH:MM" or minutes), timer (min), maxvol, dim, tzbase (minutes), tzdst (EU|none).

Payload schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "dim": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "enabled": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "maxvol": {
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "start": {
      "type": ["string", "integer"]
    },
    "stop": {
      "type": ["string", "integer"]
    },
    "timer": {
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "tzbase": {
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "tzdst": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "type": "object"
}
```

### `bedtime.sleep`

Starts (seconds or minutes, or mode = track) or cancels the sleep timer.

Payload schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "cancel": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "minutes": {
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "mode": {
      "enum": ["track"],
      "type": "string"
    },
    "seconds": {
      "type": "integer"
    }
  },
  "type": "object"
}
```

Payload schema:

```json

  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "appId": {
      "type": ["string", "integer"]
    },
    "appName": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "appVersion": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "token": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": ["appId", "appName", "appVersion", "token"],
  "type": "object"
}
```


### `playback.next`

Next track (repeat-all wraps).

No payload.

### `playback.pause`

Pauses (web radios are stopped).

No payload.

### `playback.play`

Plays a playlist (optional 1-based track index). Audiobooks resume where they stopped.

Payload schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "index": {
      "minimum": 1,
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "playlist": {
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": ["playlist"],
  "type": "object"
}
```

### `playback.prev`

Previous track, or restart after 5 s.

No payload.

### `playback.resume`

Continues (with the rewind rules of docs/19).

No payload.


### `playlist.update`

Renames / links a character (star, or false to unlink) / reorders or removes tracks / sets audiobook. On TRASH only `tracks` is allowed: files really unused are deleted.

Payload schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "audiobook": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "id": {
      "maxLength": 80,
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string"
    },
    "star": {
      "type": ["string", "boolean"]
    },
    "title": {
      "maxLength": 200,
      "type": "string"
    },
    "tracks": {
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "maxItems": 2000,
      "type": "array"
    }
  },
  "required": ["id"],
  "type": "object"
}
```

Names (or clears the name of) a physical token; optional image.

Payload schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "image": {
      "type": ["string", "boolean"]
    },
    "name": {
      "maxLength": 100,
      "type": ["string", "boolean"]
    },
    "tagId": {
      "maxLength": 14,

      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": ["tagId"],
  "type": "object"
}
```
